turns.customer: Hi, I'm going abroad for work in February.
blocks: I can help you plan boarding while you’re away. Is your pet a dog or cat, and what dates in February are you considering? Boarding is charged by the day, and I can estimate the cost once I know the dates and suite or condo type. I can’t check availability or make a reservation.

turns.customer: I'll be away 12 nights in February. Do you have a cheaper rate for longer stays, like a 10-night package? Standard suite for my collie Skye.
blocks: There’s no listed 10-night package or longer-stay discount for one dog. The Standard Suite rate is **$65 per billed day**, and the full-day charge applies regardless of drop-off time. Since boarding is billed by the day, 12 nights alone doesn’t establish the exact number of billed days. If you share Skye’s drop-off and pick-up dates, I can estimate the total.
